Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly deduced that the successor to One Raffles Place as the "tallest building outside North America" was the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur (completed 1998). This is a factual error. The Petronas Towers became the world's tallest building in 1998, but they were not the *immediate* successor to One Raffles Place in the specific category of "tallest outside North America." One Raffles Place (280m) was surpassed by the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong (367m) in 1989. The Petronas Towers (452m) were significantly taller and built later; while they certainly surpassed the height of One Raffles Place, the Bank of China Tower was the specific building that held the title of "tallest outside North America" immediately after One Raffles Place ceased to hold it. The Planner failed to distinguish between the immediate historical successor and later, much taller global records.
